owner_creation.analysis: The size_helpdata exported c_int owns the default help payload length, zero-initialized then assigned 17587 minus one by the static initializer.
owner_creation.invariant: Default help size is a representable inline integer.
limitations: size_helpdata owns the literal-size scalar rather than the selected help owner.

aliases_escapes.analysis: lmsg.rs:2592 copies the size_helpdata value into size_help_data; no source hands out an owning pointer to this integer.
aliases_escapes.invariant: The default length is copied rather than transferred.
limitations: The fixed help image is reviewed here; lmsg allocated replacements, help_data aliases and retained-input owners remain separate pending reviews.
The copied default size does not validate a later translated help_data allocation.

callback_targets.analysis: c2rust_run_static_initializers is the sole writer, selected by INIT_ARRAY; the size_helpdata length itself is never interpreted as a callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Callback dispatch is separate from the size value.
limitations: Static initialization determines default size without a retained runtime callback.

invalidation.analysis: The size_helpdata integer retains its image address and value after startup; translated help changes a different size_help_data variable.
invalidation.invariant: Changing translated help cannot resize this field.

mutation_commit.analysis: The size_helpdata initializer derives length from the exact array type and subtracts one; 17586 fits c_int on the supported target.
mutation_commit.invariant: Default length matches the compiled backing array.

release_pair.analysis: The size_helpdata scalar needs no free/close pair; copying it into message state transfers no ownership of the default help bytes.
release_pair.invariant: Length metadata has no independent release obligation.
limitations: A size reset cannot release allocated translation text.

error_cleanup.analysis: The size_helpdata initializer computes size_of of a nonempty fixed array minus one; it acquires no fallible resource.
error_cleanup.invariant: Size initialization cannot leave a partial allocation.

signals_handoff.analysis: The loader invokes the size_helpdata initializer before application main and registered handlers; there is no later maintained writer.
signals_handoff.invariant: Default size is fixed before application signal setup.

src/lmsg.rs.relationship: src/lmsg.rs:2587-2592 copies size_helpdata when restoring default help, while src/lmsg.rs:2554-2561 installs a translated size. Thus the static default scalar does not own selected help_data geometry.
